title: Error envelope (any command with --json)
description: Printed on stdout for a non-zero exit with --json. Exit 20 has code refused with reason set; reason is null elsewhere; retryable and unknown_outcome are booleans on exit 12 and exit 1 and null on exit 2 and 20; retry_after_s is set only for rate_limited (the tool's own backoff, not a server hint). message and details are fixed strings.
